  Melbourne | Full-Time | $80,000 - $110,000 + Super | Career Growth Opportunity  
 An established mortgage brokerage with over 20 years of success is experiencing significant business growth and is looking to welcome an experienced Client-Facing Parabroker to their expanding team. 
 With a strong pipeline of quality leads and an excellent reputation in the industry, this is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing business where you'll work closely with brokers, clients, and lenders while being supported by an experienced team and offshore processing support. 
 The Role 
 As a Client-Facing Parabroker, you will play a key role in supporting the lending process from application through to settlement. You'll be the main point of contact for clients throughout their journey, ensuring a smooth and efficient experience. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 
 Support brokers throughout the end-to-end loan application process. 
 
 
 Liaise directly with clients, lenders, and other stakeholders. 
 
 
 Prepare and manage loan documentation. 
 
 
 Monitor applications and proactively progress files to settlement. 
 
 
 Work collaboratively with offshore processing support. 
 
 
 Provide exceptional customer service and regular client updates. 
 
 
 Maintain accurate records using the business CRM system. 
 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you will have: 
 
 
 Previous experience as a Parabroker, Lending Support Officer, Loan Processor, Credit Analyst, or a similar role within the mortgage industry. 
 
 
 Confidence communicating directly with clients and lenders. 
 
 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 
 
 Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple applications simultaneously. 
 
 
 High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving. 
 
 
 Experience with Connective or Nexus CRM (highly regarded). 
 
 
 What's On Offer 
 
 
 Salary of  $80,000 - $110,000 + Super , depending on experience. 
 
 
 Join a well-established brokerage with over two decades of success. 
 
 
 Consistent workflow and a growing client base. 
 
 
 Offshore processing support, allowing you to focus on client relationships and file progression. 
 
 
 Supportive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture. 
 
 
 Genuine career development opportunities. 
 
 
 Flexible work arrangements available following a successful onboarding period and achievement of KPIs. 
 
 
 A business that values autonomy, trust, and professional growth without micromanagement.

result.description:
Food & Beverage Supervisor – Roebuck Bay Hotel

Location: Broome, WA
Employment Type: Full Time
Salary: $80,000 per annum

About Us

The Roebuck Bay Hotel, affectionately known as “The Roey”, is one of Broome’s most iconic venues, offering a vibrant mix of hospitality, entertainment and accommodation. With a rich history and strong community presence, we pride ourselves on delivering outstanding service and creating memorable experiences for our guests.

About the Role

As a Food & Beverage Supervisor, you will oversee and support the Food & Beverage team in the delivery of efficient and high-quality food and beverage service across your assigned area.

The role includes supervising and training staff, providing exceptional customer service, assisting with stock control, cash handling and daily operational requirements, and ensuring compliance with RSA, food safety and hygiene requirements.

You will work closely with the Approved Manager and other operational teams to maintain high service standards in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities
Oversee and supervise the Food & Beverage team to ensure smooth and efficient daily service.
Deliver outstanding customer service and respond to guest enquiries, feedback and concerns.
Train and support Food & Beverage attendants in service standards and operational procedures.
Oversee POS transactions, cash handling and till reconciliation procedures.
Assist with stock control, stock transfers, restocking and accurate recording of wastage.
Ensure compliance with RSA, liquor licensing, food safety, hygiene and workplace health and safety requirements.
Assist with the setup, execution and pack-down of functions and events.
Liaise with kitchen staff to support the smooth coordination of food orders and service.
Ensure opening, closing, cleaning and operational procedures are completed as required.
Maintain high standards of presentation, service and professionalism throughout the assigned food and beverage area.
About You
At least one year of relevant full-time experience in food and beverage operations.
Previous experience as a Food & Beverage Supervisor, Restaurant Supervisor, Restaurant Manager or similar hospitality role.
Demonstrated experience supervising and training Food & Beverage staff.
Strong customer service, communication and problem-solving skills.
Experience with POS systems, cash handling and reconciliation procedures.
Sound knowledge of food safety, hygiene and responsible service of alcohol requirements.
Current Responsible Service of Alcohol certification.
Food handling certification or equivalent experience.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and high-pressure hospitality environment.
Flexibility to work a rotating roster including evenings, weekends and public holidays.
Why Join Us?
Full-time position with a salary of $80,000 per annum.
Work in a supportive and dynamic team environment.
Career development opportunities.
Be part of one of Broome’s most established and iconic hospitality venues.
How to Apply

Email your resume and cover letter to hr@roebuckbayhotel.com.au.

The Roebuck Bay Hotel is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Offshore Staff Assist 
All States and Territory’s in Australia
Local and FIFO positions available 
Mechanical / Electrical (Trades & Services)
Full time
$70,000 – $200,000 per annum

Vacancy Listing Dates 09/07/2026 to 10/08/2026

Explore a world of career opportunities with us across every state of Australia, including New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, the Australian Capital Territory, and the Northern Territory. Join our dynamic team today and start your journey in the state that feels like home.

Offshore Staff Assist is currently hiring for a broad range of positions across various sectors on behalf of our client. We recognize your enthusiasm for becoming a part of our team and are keen to support your professional development. Our focus on excellence and innovation is at the core of our business, offering a solid foundation for your skills to develop and succeed. 
We are not just offering jobs, but long-term career opportunities that promise growth and advancement within the company we service. If you're looking for a role where your contributions are valued and your professional growth is a priority, please join us to build a future where your career aspirations align with our commitment to progress and hard work.
We're currently looking for qualified: 
•	Motor Mechanic (General)
•	Auto Electrician 
•	Diesel Motor Mechanic
•	Small Engine Mechanic (Including Outboard)
•	Upholsterer (Outboard/Marine, Vehicle and Custom)
•	Motorcycle Mechanic 
•	Fitter General (Including Heavy)

To be considered for the below roles, you must have a minimum 3 years’ experience.

Motor Mechanic (General)
We are seeking a skilled Motor Vehicle Mechanic to join our team. The ideal candidate will be experienced in diagnosing and repairing various makes and models of cars, utilizing advanced diagnostic tools to troubleshoot issues, and performing routine maintenance and repairs. A strong understanding of automotive systems and a commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship are essential.
Auto Electrician
Join our team as an Auto Electrician, where you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing electrical wiring and electronic components in motor vehicles. The ideal candidate should have expertise in reading technical diagrams and manuals, as well as a solid foundation in handling various electrical systems within the automotive industry.
Diesel Motor Mechanic
We are looking for a Diesel Motor Mechanic to manage the maintenance and repair of diesel engines. The role involves inspecting engine components, diagnosing issues for efficient resolution, and performing preventive maintenance to ensure the longevity and reliability of diesel-powered vehicles. Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and techniques for diesel engines is required.
Small Engine Mechanic (Including Outboard)
Our team requires a Small Engine Mechanic skilled in repairing and maintaining engines used in power equipment such as lawn mowers, chain saws, and snow blowers. Candidates should possess detailed knowledge of small engine operations and the ability to troubleshoot fuel, mechanical, and electrical systems effectively.
Outboard mechanics must test and repair boat engines and related, electrical systems, navigational equipment, hulls, propellers. Including steering and air conditioning where required.
Upholsterer (Outboard/Marine, Vehicle and Custom)
We seek an upholsterer with experience working on outboard, vehicles including light and heavy rigid. Experience in seat, fit out repair. Fixing trim, making repairs to wooden frames and items, removal of defective equipment and materials. Experience on custom made manifolds, wrappings and bespoke material and equipment. Cost analysis and repair estimation of items, fabric and materials required.
Motorcycle Mechanic
We are in search of a Motorcycle Mechanic to handle diagnostics, repairs, and servicing of motorcycles and similar vehicles. This role requires a deep understanding of motorcycle mechanics, including engine components, suspension, and electrical systems. The ideal candidate should demonstrate a passion for motorcycles and a drive to deliver excellent service.
Fitter General (Including Heavy)
A Fitter position is available for professional skill in maintaining and repairing automated systems, plant and also heavy-duty machinery and equipment. Responsibilities include performing major repair work, conducting inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations, and troubleshooting hydraulic and pneumatic systems. Experience with construction, mining, or agricultural machinery is highly advantageous.
